notes.content:
[p]The hidden body of the dungeon — its sounds, its symbols, its unfinished desires — is now yours.

Not yet visible — but already pulsing.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195029/96630fddc60346d282378334e3751d61399448ec.png"][/img][/p]

notes.content:
[p][b]Dungeon of Delights[/b] is now [b]70% off[/b] during the Steam Seasonal Sale.[/p][p]You don’t simply explore this dungeon — you are transformed by it.

notes.title: Dungeon of Delights – Artbook + OST – 50% Off
notes.content:
The soul of the dungeon — its shadows, its sounds, its forbidden beauty — is now yours.
The Artbook and Original Soundtrack for Dungeon of Delights are 50% off until June 2.

The Artbook reveals the unseen — rough lines, whispered shapes, forbidden silhouettes, and the ritual behind the creation of this dreamlike descent.

The Original Soundtrack lets you carry the atmosphere with you — echoes of chambers, steps on forgotten floors, breaths behind closed doors, and melodies that still pulse with tension, mystery, and desire.

But even as you lose yourself in these fragments...
A new fugue is stirring.

A shadow forms.
A sketch lingers — left behind during the birth of what comes next.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195029/f45f4103e4e9d18a634a0a8ef1c19064f0774045.png[/img]
The walls tremble softly.
The Dream reshapes itself — as it always does.

notes.title: Dungeon of Delights – 50% Off
notes.content:
[h1]Dungeon of Delights is now 50% off until June 2.[/h1]

A descent into a dungeon unlike any other — where the walls breathe desire, and every step is a trial of temptation, surrender, and resistance.
No light guides you here. Only the echoes of choices made... and the delights they awaken.

This is a place for those who dare to lose themselves — and perhaps, to find something deeper within the labyrinth of the Dream.

[h2]And yet...[/h2]
The echoes from another fugue have begun.

A resonance.
A tremor just beyond these dungeon walls.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195029/5c877aa1a61f85b826c54147595fdf4fdafc74e1.png[/img]
(A sketch has surfaced — a glimpse of something still in the making, something yet unnamed...)

The Dream never ends. It only transforms.

notes.title: Dungeon DLCs — Sound and Silence from the Depths (50% off)
notes.content:
[i]Some memories echo.
Some memories burn.
And some… stay etched in silence.[/i]

This week, the OST and Artbook of Dungeon of Delights open with 50% off 
— a rare moment to immerse yourself deeper into Elylah’s most enigmatic descent.

 The Original Soundtrack is composed entirely by the creator of the series. Lofi-mastered, dream-infused, and sensually restrained for private immersion. Expect ritual beats, cathedral echoes, murmurs of leather and devotion, and the breath of Vulpes behind closed doors.

 [h3]The Artbook is not a gallery — it’s a confession.[/h3]
Dozens of original illustrations, concept sketches, and unfiltered erotica from the dungeon’s heart. All presented in high resolution for close contemplation or print.

[h3]This is the full descent.[/h3]
Not just the game — but the sound that wrapped around it, and the vision that dared not speak during play.


And as the dungeon quiets, you may start to hear something else…

A pulse. A rhythm.
The first notes of the next composition.
[h1]The fugue is coming.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195029/f7d80806d6f68b41980680c4d38e2b2453cfd5f3.png[/img]

notes.title: Dungeon of Delights — The Descent Was Never Meant to Be Easy
notes.content:
[h1]Not all pleasure begins with light.[/h1]
[h2]Some of it begins in silence. In stone. In shadow. In submission.[/h2]

Dungeon of Delights is the third chapter in the saga of Elylah and Vulpes — a descent into the sacred interior of a daemonic dream. This is the most introspective and ritualistic journey of the series so far.

[h2]You’ll encounter:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Erotic tension blooming in confinement
[*] 
[*] Hidden layers of Vulpes’ pain and memory
[*] 
[*] The Sisterhood of Vesta in their full ascetic beauty
[*] 
[*] And the final conquest: naming the dungeon with your own hands
[/list]

  [h3]This isn’t a game about escaping.[/h3]
 It’s about surrendering — and discovering who you become after.

  [h2]This week, the Dungeon opens at 50% off.[/h2]

 And just beyond these chambers… something stirs.
 A new fugue forms in the dark, where seduction is no longer a trap, but a weapon.

Elylah is composing again.

 And for those who’ve longed to hold this passage in stillness, a special illustrated collection is nearing completion.

 Let the descent begin — or repeat.
 Some dungeons never forget you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195029/77b56348e0f106ae329f9a57991f0a1bdee76b6c.png[/img]
